name: tegy-openai
description: Explicit decision-review gate backed by Tegy's independent hosted reviewer.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit independent review before a decision
interface.longDescription: Select a decision boundary, submit one complete immutable decision packet, and wait for Tegy's independent reviewer before presenting the decision. The gate returns pass, revise, block, or no-result behavior and never invokes implicitly.
defaultPrompt: Gate this complete decision packet before I present it
Review this recommendation and its assumptions
